targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(bucket, '1h') AS time, outcome AS metric, sum(n)::float AS value FROM caib.events_5m WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT actor, sum(n) AS events, sum(failures) AS failures FROM caib.actors_1h WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND bucket > now() - interval '24 hours' AND actor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT action, sum(n) AS events FROM caib.events_5m WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND bucket > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY action ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT event_time, actor, action, attrs->>'sub_status' AS sub_status, host(src_ip) AS src_ip FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND outcome = 'failure' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT coalesce(attrs->>'category', 'unknown') AS category, count(*) AS events FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND event_time > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT coalesce(attrs->>'resource_group', '-') AS resource_group, count(*) AS events FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND event_time > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Raw event stream
panels.description: Newest azure_activity events in the selected range. Click a cell in attrs/raw to inspect the full JSON; column headers filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, actor, action, target, outcome, severity, host(src_ip) AS src_ip, attrs::text AS attrs, raw::text AS raw FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'azure_activity' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100
